name: Saouji Meguru
source:
Meguru has a gentle face that could be mistaken for a girl, but in reality he is a boy. Possessing an angelic singing voice, he was seen as having a promising future as a countertenor singer, but after encountering Yasaka Fuuri at a hospital and being touched by her weakness, he began to wish to protect her. Fuuri also occasionally obeys Meguru when she is scolded by him. He has a timid and hesitant personality, but he can muster the courage to be strong for Fuuri's sake.

[Translated from [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=611505]Getchu[/url]]
